overview.description: The ProShares Ultra Copper K-1 Free ETF (UCOP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in copper commodities. The fund seeks 2x the daily performance of copper prices through derivatives linked to copper exposure. The strategy uses swaps and cash collateral rather than investing directly in physical copper UCOP was launched on Apr 20, 2026 and is issued by ProShares.
